mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO earnings_forecast_snapshot(instrument_id, observation_date, available_at, source, source_url, content_hash, metrics_json, raw_json, fetched_at) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{observationDate}, #{availableAt}, 'EASTMONEY_PUBLIC', #{sourceUrl}, #{contentHash}, #{metricsJson}, #{rawJson}, #{availableAt})
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.instrument_id, f.observation_date, f.available_at, f.source, f.source_url, f.content_hash, f.metrics_json, f.raw_json, f.fetched_at FROM earnings_forecast_snapshot f JOIN instrument i ON i.id=f.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol=#{symbol} AND f.available_at<=#{cutoff} ORDER BY f.available_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT 30
